Monthly Market Review: Reporting Period (MKT_UK, en)
In the reporting period the Engaged segment clearly over-indexed on Thames Cash. Players in the Engaged segment bought Thames Cash far more often than the market average. The product is built on the mechanic “Randomly selected number lines”. The trend held from 2025-03-02 to 2025-08-29 and should inform the next product plan.

This document covers Retail QR cross-sell. The experiment targeted the Občasní player segment. Stakeholders agreed to revisit Retail QR cross-sell (EXP_008) at the next monthly review. blocks.title: Monthly Market Review: Reporting Period
blocks.text:
Monthly Market Review: Reporting Period (MKT_UK, en)
In the reporting period the Engaged segment clearly over-indexed on Thames Cash. Players in the Engaged segment bought Thames Cash far more often than the market average. The product is built on the mechanic “Randomly selected number lines”. The trend held from 2025-03-02 to 2025-08-29 and should inform the next product plan.

Experiment Report: Retail QR cross-sell (EXP_002) (en)

The market team in Greece (MKT_GR) confirmed the timeline with the central team. Variant and control groups were drawn from the Αδρανείς segment. The next review is scheduled with the market operations team.

Το περιστατικό INC_041 καταγράφηκε ως «Αστάθεια εφαρμογής» στις 2025-04-06. Το ταμείο σε συσκευές iOS κολλούσε μετά την ενημέρωση στην έκδοση εφαρμογής APPV_GR_530. claims.statement: Game GAME_CZ_04 belongs to game family FAM_CZ_STIRACI_LOS.
Game GAME_GR_05 belongs to game family FAM_GR_STIGMIAIO.
Game GAME_UK_05 belongs to game family FAM_UK_SCRATCHCARD.

A.answer: Game GAME_AT_05 (Edelweiss Instant) belongs to the 'Rubbellos' product family [1]. The games in other markets that belong to the same kind of game family (Scratchcard/Rubbellos) are Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05), which is explicitly identified as belonging to the Scratchcard product family [4], [5], [6], [7], [9], [12]. Peloponnesus Pull (GAME_GR_05) also belongs to a scratch-to-reveal family (Στιγμιαίο Λαχείο, which translates to Instant Lottery/Scratchcard contextually similar to Rubbellos mechanics) [11], but Lioness Instant is the primary match for the 'Scratchcard' terminology used in the English sources for the UK market. Alpen Star and Alpen Jackpot belong to different families (Zusatzspiel and Länderübergreifender Jackpot respectively) [8], [13]. SwiftSix belongs to Online Instant [14]. Ellas Jackpot belongs to Πολυεθνικό Τζάκποτ [15].

C.answer: The game mechanic described as "Instant win rounds on every ticket" is identified as MECH_UK_INSTANT_ROUNDS in the United Kingdom market [4]. The game SwiftSix (GAME_UK_06) uses this specific mechanic [6]. Additionally, the concept of Instant rounds maps to the Greek mechanic AMESOI_GYROI, which is described as "Άμεσοι γύροι κερδών ανά δελτίο" (Instant win rounds per ticket) and is used by the game Athena Express (GAME_GR_04) in the Greece market [8][12]. While other games like Edelweiss Instant and Stastny Kupon are noted as similar to SwiftSix, they use different mechanics (RUBBELN and STIRANI respectively) [10][16].

Monthly Market Review: Reporting Period (MKT_UK, en)
In the reporting period the Engaged segment clearly over-indexed on Albion Millions. Players in the Engaged segment bought Albion Millions far more often than the market average. The product is built on the mechanic “Randomly selected number lines”. The trend held from 2025-03-02 to 2025-08-29 and should inform the next product plan.

A.answer: The main mechanic of game GAME_CZ_02 (Moravia Multi) is 'Výběr čísel a porovnání s losováním' (Select numbers and compare with the draw) [1]. In other markets, the game Kingsport Draw (GAME_UK_02) uses the core mechanic 'Match your numbers against the draw' [11], which corresponds to the same kind of number matching mechanic. Additionally, Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) is described with the mechanic 'Scratch to reveal matching symbols' in some contexts [13], but its rules specify 'Scratch to reveal matching symbols' as well [18]. However, looking at the specific phrasing 'Match your numbers against the draw' for Kingsport Draw [11] and 'Výběr čísel a porovnání s losováním' for Moravia Multi [2], these are functionally equivalent number-picking games. Lioness Instant is a scratchcard game [13]. Therefore, only Kingsport Draw uses the same kind of mechanic.

A.answer: The game Alpen Star uses the mechanic described as "Nieten nehmen an einer zweiten Ziehung teil" [1]. This is confirmed by multiple sources indicating that Alpen Star belongs to the product family 'Zusatzspiel' and utilizes this specific core game mechanic (MECH_AT_ZWEITE_CHANCE) [2], [3], [4], [5]. The warehouse record for GAME_AT_04 explicitly lists the mechanics as ZWEITE_CHANCE, which corresponds to losing entries participating in a second draw [6]. While other games like Union Raffle use a similar concept ("Losing entries go into a second draw"), they are associated with different market codes and mechanic identifiers (MECH_UK_SECOND_CHANCE) rather than the specific German phrase requested [8], [9]. Danube Classic uses a different mechanic involving number selection [10], [11]. Therefore, only Alpen Star is identified as using this specific mechanic description.

blocks.text:
Product Spec: Danube Classic (GAME_AT_01) (MKT_AT, de)
Arbeitsnotizen zum Thema: Danube Classic. Das Spiel gehört zur Produktfamilie Zahlenziehung. Die zentrale Spielmechanik lautet: Zahlen wählen und mit der Ziehung vergleichen. Die Kampagne Second Chance Season AT (CMP_011) hat das Spiel im Zeitraum beworben. Das Marktteam für Österreich (MKT_AT) hat den Zeitplan mit der Zentrale bestätigt. Das Spiel war im Zeitraum vom Vorfall Anmeldestörung (INC_011) betroffen. Die Verantwortung für offene Punkte liegt bei der Produktverantwortung.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001) (MKT_UK, en)
The following notes concern New Season Start UK (CMP_001). The campaign promoted Kingsport Draw to active and lapsed players. Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. The market team in United Kingdom confirmed the timeline with the central team. Creative assets highlighted the Annuity Draw product family. Risks were reviewed with the finance and legal stakeholders. Stakeholders agreed to revisit New Season Start UK at the next monthly review. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: Second Chance Season UK (CMP_003) (MKT_UK, en)
The following notes concern Second Chance Season UK. Creative assets highlighted the Online Instant product family. Stakeholders agreed to revisit Second Chance Season UK (CMP_003) at the next monthly review. The campaign ran across digital channels and retail outlets. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Responsible gaming obligations were checked with the compliance lead. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Marketing Brief: Second Chance Season CZ (CMP_015)
blocks.text:
Marketing Brief: Second Chance Season CZ (CMP_015) (MKT_CZ, cs)
Pracovní poznámky k tématu: Second Chance Season CZ (CMP_015). Povinnosti v oblasti odpovědného hraní byly ověřeny s útvarem compliance. Kampaň běžela v digitálních kanálech i na prodejních místech. Tržní tým pro trh Česko (MKT_CZ) potvrdil harmonogram s centrálou. Zpětná vazba od prodejců byla sebrána při pravidelných návštěvách v terénu. Prodeje na prodejních místech a v digitálních kanálech byly porovnány po týdnech. Rozpočet kampaně zůstal v rámci schváleného limitu. Za otevřené body odpovídá vlastník produktu.

blocks.title: BusinessConcept: CONCEPT_SYMBOL_REVEAL
blocks.text:

Ο βασικός μηχανισμός του παιχνιδιού είναι: Άμεσοι γύροι κερδών ανά δελτίο (MECH_GR_AMESOI_GYROI). Οι πωλήσεις στα πρακτορεία και στα ψηφιακά κανάλια συγκρίθηκαν ανά εβδομάδα. Η ομάδα της αγοράς Ελλάδα (MKT_GR) επιβεβαίωσε το χρονοδιάγραμμα με την κεντρική ομάδα. Η ομάδα προϊόντος εξέτασε την πορεία σε σχέση με το τριμηνιαίο πλάνο. Οι επαφές των πελατών παρακολουθήθηκαν μέσω των συνήθων καναλιών εξυπηρέτησης. Η επόμενη αξιολόγηση προγραμματίζεται με την τοπική ομάδα λειτουργιών.

Support cases linked to this incident confirm that the application froze after updating to version 5.3.0 [5], [6], [7], [8].

C.answer: Yes, the game Edelweiss Instant (GAME_AT_05) is available on digital channels. The support cases concerning this game, SUP_00055 and SUP_00071, are categorized under 'Kontozugang' (Account Access) within the Austria market [12][16]. Furthermore, the concept of 'Digital Channel' explicitly includes mobile applications and web portals as synonyms for digital sales channels [2]. While the specific game record for GAME_AT_05 lists only 'RETAIL' in its channels field [4], the existence of support cases related to account access implies a digital interaction point, and more importantly, other games like Athena Express (GAME_GR_04) explicitly list 'APP' and 'WEB' as channels [7]. However, looking strictly at the provided text for GAME_AT_05, it only lists RETAIL. Let's re-evaluate. The question asks if it is *available* on digital channels. Source [4] says channels: RETAIL. Source [12] and [16] are support cases for GAME_AT_05 with category 'Kontozugang'. Usually, account access is a digital feature. But does the source explicitly say it's available on digital channels? Source [2] defines Digital Channel as sales through mobile app or web portal. Source [4] says GAME_AT_05 channels are RETAIL. This suggests it might NOT be on digital channels based on the game record. However, let's look at INC_019 which affects GAME_AT_05 and is an 'Authentication outage' on 'Identity Service' platform [8]. Authentication is typically a digital feature. Also, INC_003 and INC_023 are 'App-Instabilität' affecting games including Edelweiss Instant [1][3]. If the app crashes for this game, it implies the game is present in the app. Therefore, it is available on the mobile app, which is a digital channel.

blocks.text:

This document covers App stability. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Affected games included Union Raffle. Customer contacts were monitored through the usual support channels. App release 5.3.1 (APPV_UK_531) was in use when the incident started. Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. The affected game belongs to the Fixed Prize Raffle (FAM_UK_FIXED_PRIZE) product family. No further action is required for this reporting period.

Kontakty zákazníků byly sledovány běžnými kanály podpory. Pro toto období nejsou potřeba žádná další opatření.

instance.text: Which incidents in other markets are the same kind of incident as incident INC_008?
instance.expected_answer: The incidents in other markets of the same kind as INC_008 (Identity incident) are INC_002, INC_009, INC_011, INC_019 and INC_022.

claims.statement: Incident INC_002 has incident type ITYPE_GR_SYNDESI.
Incident INC_009 has incident type ITYPE_UK_SIGN_IN.
Incident INC_011 has incident type ITYPE_CORP_IDENTITY.
Incident INC_019 has incident type ITYPE_CORP_IDENTITY.
Incident INC_022 has incident type ITYPE_GR_SYNDESI.

A.answer: Incident INC_008 is a sign-in failure (type: ITYPE_CZ_PRIHLASENI) occurring on the Web Portal platform [3]. To find incidents of the same kind in other markets, we look for other sign-in or login failures. Incident INC_015 is categorized as 'App-Instabilität' but its summary states 'Reporting pipelines delayed; no customer impact', which does not match the sign-in failure nature of INC_008 [11]. However, incident INC_002 is a connection interruption (type: ITYPE_GR_SYNDESI) on the Web Portal platform with the summary 'Sign-in failures for a subset of accounts' [15]. While INC_015 is in Austria and INC_002 is in Greece, neither perfectly matches the specific type code of INC_008. Let's re-evaluate based on the functional description 'Sign-in failures'. INC_008 summary: 'Sign-in failures for a subset of accounts' [3]. INC_015 summary: 'Reporting pipelines delayed; no customer impact' [11] - this is not a sign-in failure. INC_002 summary: 'Sign-in failures for a subset of accounts' [15]. Therefore, INC_002 is the same kind of incident (sign-in failure) in another market (Greece). Are there others? INC_009 is mentioned in source [12] as a 'Sign-in outage', but no detailed record with market/type is provided in the numbered list to confirm it is in a different market or to cite its details properly against the specific question constraints which ask for incidents from the sources. The sources explicitly link INC_008 to support cases in UK and Greece [2, 4, 6], but those are support cases, not incidents of the same kind. The only other incident explicitly described as having 'Sign-in failures' is INC_002 [15]. Thus, INC_002 is the answer.

A.answer: The main mechanic of game Peloponnesus Pull (GAME_GR_05) is XYSIMO, which involves scratching to reveal symbols [1]. blocks.text:
Support Summary: Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04) (MKT_UK, en)
This document covers Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04). The game belongs to the Fixed Prize Raffle product family. The core game mechanic is: Losing entries go into a second draw (MECH_UK_SECOND_CHANCE). The campaign New Season Start UK (CMP_001) promoted the game during the period. Customer contacts were monitored through the usual support channels. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Responsible gaming obligations were checked with the compliance lead. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001) (MKT_UK, en)
Scope of this document: New Season Start UK (CMP_001). Risks were reviewed with the finance and legal stakeholders. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. The campaign promoted Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) to active and lapsed players. Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. Feedback from retailers was collected during the regular field visits. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Marketing Brief: Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006)
blocks.text:
Marketing Brief: Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006) (MKT_GR, en)
This document covers Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006). Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. Stakeholders agreed to revisit Twin Ticket Trail GR (CMP_006) at the next monthly review. Feedback from retailers was collected during the regular field visits. The campaign promoted Peloponnesus Pull (GAME_GR_05) to active and lapsed players. Open actions are tracked in the shared operations log. Campaign spend stayed within the approved budget. The next review is scheduled with the market operations team.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017) (MKT_UK, en)
The campaign Instant Cross-Sell Push UK promoted Lioness Instant (Scratchcard) to the Engaged segment from 2025-04-11 to 2025-05-21. 70 percent of exposed players engaged with the campaign. 46 percent of engaged players went on to buy Lioness Instant. The result is well above our usual campaign response and the approach is worth repeating.

blocks.title: Monthly Market Review: Danube Classic (GAME_AT_01)
blocks.text:
Monthly Market Review: Danube Classic (GAME_AT_01) (MKT_AT, de)
Arbeitsnotizen zum Thema: Danube Classic. Das Spiel gehört zur Produktfamilie Zahlenziehung. Die zentrale Spielmechanik lautet: Zahlen wählen und mit der Ziehung vergleichen. Umsätze in Annahmestellen und digitalen Kanälen wurden wochenweise verglichen. Die Kampagne Second Chance Season AT (CMP_011) hat das Spiel im Zeitraum beworben. Das Marktteam für Österreich hat den Zeitplan mit der Zentrale bestätigt. Offene Maßnahmen werden im gemeinsamen Betriebsprotokoll verfolgt. Die Verantwortung für offene Punkte liegt bei der Produktverantwortung.

blocks.title: Support Summary: Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04)
blocks.text:
Support Summary: Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04) (MKT_UK, en)
This document covers Union Raffle (GAME_UK_04). The game belongs to the Fixed Prize Raffle product family. The core game mechanic is: Losing entries go into a second draw (MECH_UK_SECOND_CHANCE). The campaign New Season Start UK (CMP_001) promoted the game during the period. Customer contacts were monitored through the usual support channels. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. Responsible gaming obligations were checked with the compliance lead. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: New Season Start UK (CMP_001) (MKT_UK, en)
Scope of this document: New Season Start UK (CMP_001). Risks were reviewed with the finance and legal stakeholders. Figures in this document are taken from the central reporting warehouse. The campaign promoted Lioness Instant (GAME_UK_05) to active and lapsed players. Retail and digital sales were compared week by week across the period. Feedback from retailers was collected during the regular field visits. No further action is required for this reporting period.

blocks.title: Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017)
blocks.text:
Campaign Evaluation: Instant Cross-Sell Push UK (CMP_017) (MKT_UK, en)
The campaign Instant Cross-Sell Push UK promoted Lioness Instant (Scratchcard) to the Engaged segment from 2025-04-11 to 2025-05-21. 70 percent of exposed players engaged with the campaign. 46 percent of engaged players went on to buy Lioness Instant. The result is well above our usual campaign response and the approach is worth repeating.

blocks.title: Monthly Market Review: Danube Classic (GAME_AT_01)
blocks.text:
Monthly Market Review: Danube Classic (GAME_AT_01) (MKT_AT, de)
Arbeitsnotizen zum Thema: Danube Classic. Das Spiel gehört zur Produktfamilie Zahlenziehung. Die zentrale Spielmechanik lautet: Zahlen wählen und mit der Ziehung vergleichen. Umsätze in Annahmestellen und digitalen Kanälen wurden wochenweise verglichen. Die Kampagne Second Chance Season AT (CMP_011) hat das Spiel im Zeitraum beworben. Das Marktteam für Österreich hat den Zeitplan mit der Zentrale bestätigt. Offene Maßnahmen werden im gemeinsamen Betriebsprotokoll verfolgt. Die Verantwortung für offene Punkte liegt bei der Produktverantwortung.

Incident INC_035 also occurred on this platform version but affected Edelweiss Instant; however, the source for INC_035 lists platform version PLV_RETAIL_1 (2024.1.0) [4], so it is excluded. Therefore, the affected games are Albion Millions, Thames Cash, SwiftSix, Vltava Výhra, Rychle Cisla, and Stastny Kupon.
